# Safvra Concepts

> Crafting Spaces. Building Visions. Interior Fit-Out & General Maintenance in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

Safvra Concepts is a premier turnkey interior architecture, fit-out, joinery, and general maintenance studio headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. The studio delivers commercial fit-outs, residential villa renovations, luxury retail spaces, custom millwork, kitchen cabinetry, and building maintenance services across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and the wider UAE.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Commercial Fit-Out: Corporate offices, executive boardrooms, acoustic partitions, turnkey MEP coordination.
- Residential Fit-Out: Luxury villas, penthouses, bespoke living spaces, private residential renovation.
- Retail Fit-Out: Flagship boutiques, jewelry vitrines, high-spec commercial showrooms.
- Design & Build (Turnkey): End-to-end 3D spatial planning, authority approvals, procurement, and site execution.
- Kitchen Installation: Custom culinary spaces, German & Italian hardware, stone countertops.
- Wood Flooring: Solid parquet, engineered timber, herringbone installation, sound-dampened underlays.
- Door Installation: Concealed hinges, magnetic latches, acoustic solid-core pivot doors.
- Wardrobe Installation: Custom walk-in dressing rooms, integrated LED illumination, bespoke millwork.
- Vanity Installation: Floating stone vanities, undermount basins, water-resistant joinery.
- Gypsum Ceiling: Multi-tier architectural bulkheads, curved vaults, perimeter shadow gaps.
- General Maintenance: Preventative MEP servicing, HVAC balancing, structural snag repairs.

## Service Areas
- Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates (Primary HQ)
- Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- All Emirates across the UAE
